title: Walk the Code Configuration
description: Schema for walk-the-code config.json — defines project metadata, group structure, unit definitions, and optional run commands for an interactive line-by-line code tutorial.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference used by editors for validation.

title.description: Project title shown on the index page.

tagline.description: Subtitle shown below the title on the index page.

repo_url.description: Repository URL (must be https) used for the GitHub corner link on tutorial pages.

language.description: Default programming language for all units. Auto-detected from file extension if omitted.

code_dir.description: Path to the code directory, relative to config.json. Defaults to the current directory.

terminology.description: Custom display names for the hierarchy levels. The JSON keys (groups, units) never change — only the UI labels do.

group.description: Singular name for a group-level grouping (e.g. Chapter, Module, Part).

group_plural.description: Plural form of group. Auto-derived by appending 's' to group if omitted.

unit.description: Singular name for a unit-level item (e.g. Lab, Lesson, Component).

unit_plural.description: Plural form of unit. Auto-derived by appending 's' to unit if omitted.

groups.description: Array of group objects that organize units into themed sections, each with its own page, description, and optional diagram.

units.description: Array of unit objects defining individual code tutorials.

analytics_file.description: Path to an HTML file (relative to config.json) whose contents are injected before </body> on all pages. Use for analytics scripts.

show_credits.description: Show a 'Generated with walk-the-code' footer on all pages. Defaults to true. Set to false to hide the visible footer (the <meta name="generator"> tag is always present).

group.description: A group organizes units into a themed section with its own page, description, and optional diagram.

title.description: Group title displayed on the group page and in navigation.

description.description: HTML description shown on the group page.

diagram.description: Inline Mermaid source rendered on the group page (raw Mermaid markup, not a file reference).

comparison_diagram.description: References a .mmd file in the diagrams/ directory, shown as a comparison diagram on the group page.

units.description: Ordered list of unit IDs belonging to this group.

knowledge_checks.description: Multiple-choice questions shown on the group page for self-assessment.

groups.description: Nested sub-groups. A group can have units, sub-groups, or both.

unit.description: A unit defines a single code file tutorial with metadata, optional run command, learning objectives, and exercises.

id.description: Unique unit identifier. Must be a valid identifier (letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens; must start with a letter, digit, or underscore). Matches a subdirectory in code_dir.

file.description: Source file to display in the tutorial viewer.

title.description: Unit title displayed in navigation and on the unit page.

tagline.description: One-line summary shown on index and group pages.

description.description: HTML overview shown in the explanation panel before any line is selected.

language.description: Override the default language for this unit. Auto-detected from file extension if omitted.

run_command.description: Command to execute the unit, specified as an array of strings. Enables the Run button in local server mode. Use ["sh", "-c", "..."] for compile-then-run languages.

learning_objectives.description: Array of strings describing what the learner will be able to do after completing this unit.

exercises.description: Array of exercise objects displayed in the unit overview panel with completion checkboxes (persisted per-browser in localStorage).

files.description: Multi-file unit definition. When present, takes precedence over 'file'. The first entry with role 'primary' (or the first entry) is the default view.

path.description: File path relative to the unit directory.

role.description: Role of the file. The primary file is shown by default.

knowledge_check.description: A multiple-choice question with one correct answer and an explanation.

correct.description: Zero-based index of the correct option.

exercise.description: An exercise prompts the learner to modify or experiment with the code.

prompt.description: The exercise instruction or question presented to the learner.

hint.description: Optional hint to help the learner complete the exercise.
